title: Produce a Frobenius element at a specified finite-field valuation
statement: Let Ω = AlgebraicClosure ℚ, and let E be a finite-dimensional Galois intermediate field of Ω/ℚ. Let ℓ be a natural prime and V a valuation subring of E in which ℓ is a nonunit. There exists a rational automorphism g of E that preserves V and acts on its residue field by x ↦ x^ℓ, in the exact sense of V.IsFrobeniusAt g ℓ.
lean_statement: ∀ (E : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) [FiniteDimensional ℚ E] [IsGalois ℚ E] (ℓ : ℕ), ℓ.Prime → ∀ (V : ValuationSubring E), V.LiesOverPrime ℓ → ∃ g : E ≃ₐ[ℚ] E, V.IsFrobeniusAt g ℓ
